title: Page Metadata Schema
description: Schema for validating the metadata.json file for a content page.

title.description: A short, descriptive title for the page. Major words typically come before minor words (e.g. 'GitHub: Introduction').

slug.description: A URL-friendly version of the title. Lowercase, hyphen-separated, with special characters removed.

description.description: A concise summary of the page content, used in search results and SEO metadata.

authors.description: A list of authors who contributed to the page content.

tags.description: A list of high-level tags relevant to the page content, used for filtering across the platform.

duration.description: Estimated time in minutes to complete the page content.

prerequisites.description: A list of page slugs that should be completed before this page.

related.description: A list of page slugs for pages related to this one.
